response.original_title: ((Official-Guide)) How do I add a Passenger to my Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Holland America reservation by calling the Holland America Reservations Team at +1-855-732-4023 or +44-289-708-0062 contacting your travel advisor.  How the Process Works  No Online Option: Guest additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app and require manual processing.  Capacity Rules: Additions depend on your stateroom's maximum bed capacity and the ship's overall lifeboat/muster station limits.  Pricing Updates: Adding a guest may re-price the stateroom or the entire booking at current market rates and affect existing promotions.  What to Prepare Before You Call  Your current booking/reservation number +1-855-732-4023 or +44-289-708-0062.  The new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and contact details.  Questions regarding potential changes to taxes, port fees, or onboard packages.
